ops.text: HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site (collectively, the "Services") will be performed in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner, for a period of 90 days following performance; (2) for a period of 12 months following the Company's written acceptance and approval of the Site pursuant to Section 5.2, the Site and each deliverable and each item of software delivered by HDI will conform to its documentation; (3) HDI's performance of the Services will comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software delivered or used by HDI in performing the Services will be free of any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software, or a refund of the fees paid by the Company with respect to the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives no warranty for the development, hosting and maintenance work HDI is paid to perform, so we add a performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Services warranted for 90 days, deliverables and software conforming to documentation for 12 months, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund as our remedy.
input.summary: Insert HDI performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Services (90 days), deliverable/software conformance to documentation (12 months), legal compliance, no malicious code, with repair/replacement/refund remedy.
